name: GetEmails
description: Retrieves email messages from a Microsoft 365 Outlook mailbox using Microsoft Graph API. Supports filtering by folder, sender, recipients, subject, unread status, importance, and attachment presence.
author: @rahmat

fields.name: __CredentialId__M365
fields.label: M365 Outlook Credential
fields.description: Microsoft 365 credential used to authenticate and access mailbox data through Microsoft Graph API.

fields.name: MailboxAddress
fields.label: Mailbox Address
fields.description: Mailbox address to retrieve emails from. Leave empty to use the authenticated user's mailbox.

fields.name: Folder
fields.label: Mailbox Folder
fields.description: The folder to retrieve emails from (e.g., Inbox, Archive, SentItems).

fields.name: FromFilter
fields.label: Filter by Sender
fields.description: Retrieve emails received from the specified sender email address.

fields.name: ToFilter
fields.label: Filter by Recipient (To)
fields.description: Retrieve emails sent to the specified recipient email address.

fields.name: CcFilter
fields.label: Filter by CC
fields.description: Retrieve emails where the specified address appears in the CC field.

fields.name: UnreadOnly
fields.label: Unread Messages Only
fields.description: If true, retrieves only unread emails.

fields.name: OnlyWithAttachments
fields.label: Only Emails with Attachments
fields.description: If true, retrieves only emails that contain attachments.

fields.name: IncludeAttachments
fields.label: Include Attachments
fields.description: If true, includes attachment details in the retrieved emails.

fields.name: SubjectContains
fields.label: Subject Contains
fields.description: Retrieve emails where the subject contains the specified text.

fields.name: Count
fields.label: Count Only
fields.description: If true, returns only the count of emails matching the criteria.

fields.name: Top
fields.label: Maximum Results
fields.description: Specifies the maximum number of emails to retrieve.

fields.name: Skip
fields.label: Skip
fields.description: Number of emails to skip from the top of the result set.

fields.name: Result
fields.label: Result
fields.description: Returns the list of retrieved emails including metadata such as subject, sender, recipients, body preview, and attachments if included.
